channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: NATO jets scramble as Russian missile detonates in Poland
item.description: The growing series of NATO airspace violations is raising concern that Russia's war on Ukraine could escalate.

item.title: IRGC video of retaliatory strikes on US targets in Jordan
item.description: The IRGC released a video of what they say were missiles launched by their naval forces targeting US aircraft in Jordan.

item.title: Is Pakistan ‘using India’s playbook’ in Kashmir?
item.description: Pakistan is facing accusations that its forces have killed unarmed protesters in Pakistan-administered Kashmir

item.title: Smoke rises over southern Iran after renewed US attacks
item.description: A large plume of smoke was seen rising over the southwestern Iranian city of Ahvaz following renewed US strikes.

item.title: War on Iran: Phase II: Day 19
item.description: The US resumes bombing Iran, with a family of three killed in Qeshm Island.

item.title: Israeli strikes kill at least four, including children, across Gaza Strip
item.description: Bombings take place as Hamas officials meet with Qatari, Egyptian and Turkish mediators in Cairo to discuss truce.

item.title: Attack on northwest Pakistan police post kills 11 officers
item.description: Fifteen attackers were also killed during the hours-long raid in Pakistan's northwestern Hangu district.

item.title: Several children killed and wounded in Israeli attacks across Gaza
item.description: Israeli strikes hit multiple areas across Gaza overnight, including tents sheltering displaced families in al-Mawasi.

item.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
item.description: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.

item.title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
item.description: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.
